newsitem.title: UK: UK magazine gets first photos of Jackson's son.
newsitem.headline: UK magazine gets first photos of Jackson's son.

text.p: The first public pictures of the new-born son of pop superstar Michael Jackson, Prince Michael Junior, appeared in a British magazine on Tuesday.

Jackson is pictured cuddling the baby boy on the front page of OK magazine in a world exclusive thought to have cost the British celebrity publication some 2.5 million pounds. His wife Debbie Rowe, 37, is also pictured.
Jackson said in an interview he had named the baby Prince Michael Junior.
"My grandfather and great grandfather were both named Prince so we have carried on the tradition," he said.
Jackson, who has always appeared more comfortable in the company of children than adults, said fatherhood was an "incredibly joyful experience". "I'm in bliss 24 hours a day," he said.

Jackson married Debbie in a Sydney hotel last year after reports that he had paid her several hundred thousand pounds to carry his baby. Prince was born in California in February and has not previously been shown off to the public.
The couple denied suggestions that their marriage was a sham.
"I have married and had a baby with the man I will always love. Im on top of the world," said Debbie.
Jackson praised Debbie's courage during childbirth and said he would "work tirelessly" at being a good father.
Jackson had a short-lived previous marriage to Lisa Marie Presley.
